7826-progress.name: Rashona Straglash
7826-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Orgrimmar for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7826-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

858-accept.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
858-accept.text:
I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.

We need to get out of here on the double! Go up to the control room at the top of the derrick, the supervisor should have a key for this shredder.

Help me out here!
858-accept.title: Ignition

858-complete.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
858-complete.text:
Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing...

Hmm... rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... fine arm movement control. Just look at this! I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. I've got to get this back to Ratchet!
858-complete.title: Ignition

858-progress.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
858-progress.text: Quick, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!
858-progress.title: Ignition

863-accept.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
863-accept.text: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?
863-accept.title: The Escape

875-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-complete.text: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the Horde.
875-complete.title: Harpy Lieutenants

875-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-progress.text: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
875-progress.title: Harpy Lieutenants

876-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-accept.text:
You did so well with the lieutenants and underlings that I'd like you to do one last thing for me.

Serena Bloodfeather is the sister of a harpy named Bloodfeather who was slain by Rexxar quite a while ago. Apparently, these attacks on the Horde caravans are revenge for her sister's death.

I need you to slit her throat and bring me back her head. I want to place it on the next caravan we send out... Give those harpies something to think about.
876-accept.title: Serena Bloodfeather

881-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-complete.text:
You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... his spirit is with you.  He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.

Your path is still long, $c.  Let's hope you stride it well.
881-complete.title: Echeyakee

881-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-progress.text: The great cat calls to you, $N.
881-progress.title: Echeyakee

896-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-complete.text:
Look at the size of that thing, $N! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!

Now let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $N.
896-complete.title: Miner's Fortune

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

905-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
905-accept.text:
Now, $N, the hunt deepens.  Now you must defeat your prey, and then find your way to its lair.

Hunt the sunscale raptors to the south.  Slay them and remove the feathers they wear.  Place the feathers on the scytheclaw nests southwest of the Stagnant Oasis. Show their brethren you do not fear them!
905-accept.title: The Angry Scytheclaws

95495-accept.name: Vrang Wildgore
95495-accept.text:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495-accept.title: The Hermit Tanner

95495-complete.name: Walton
95495-complete.text: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.
95495-complete.title: The Hermit Tanner

95495-progress.name: Walton
95495-progress.text: Greetings, $c. What brings you up to my property today?
95495-progress.title: The Hermit Tanner

95508-accept.name: Walton
95508-accept.text:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!
95508-accept.title: Unwelcome Guests

95508-complete.name: Walton
95508-complete.text:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

Safe travels, $c.
95508-complete.title: Unwelcome Guests

95621-accept.name: Walton
95621-accept.text:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
95621-accept.title: Trouble in the Valley

95621-complete.name: Walton
95621-complete.text: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.
95621-complete.title: Trouble in the Valley

95621-progress.name: Walton
95621-progress.text:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621-progress.title: Trouble in the Valley

96875-complete.name: Kamari
96875-complete.text: Your work helps Orgrimmar grow. Know that as you walk the city's paths.
96875-complete.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
